messages:
Maria G: heads-up deploybot put the staging promo on HOLD — helm lint failed and graphql-smoke 3/5 flaky tests.

deploy-bot: PROMO_HOLD staging canary v2026.3.12 -> v2026.3.13\nchecks: helm-lint: FAILED (chart/api-server.yaml: CRD apiVersion v1beta1 deprecated)\ngraphql-smoke: 3/5 failed (timeout on createMutation x2, schema mismatch x1)\nlogs: https://ci.internal/4412345678/build

Jordan: ugh. helm lint fail looks legit — CRD apiVersion in chart was updated in the chart repo yesterday. did we bump chart deps in this build?

Sam: I see two options quickly: 1) pin promotion to last-good image (v2026.3.12) and manual promote + release notes update, or 2) rerun CI after a tiny helm fix if it's just the CRD string. which is faster given the change window?

Maria G: change window ends in 45m. product wants the feature in this cut. if we pin we lose the feature. if we fix helm and rerun, we risk CI flake delaying cut. what's the confidence on graphql smoke flakes being unrelated?

Jordan: infra-bot, any insight on CI flakiness rate for graphql-smoke on staging in last 24h?

infra-bot: CI_METRICS: graphql-smoke flake rate (24h): 12%. Recent increased timeouts correlate with staging DB load spike around 03:00 UTC. No known infra outages since then.

Sam: given DB load, graphql timeouts look environmental. I'd prefer pin + follow-up patch: pin image now to meet SLA and open hotfix PR for chart + re-run canary during next window. minimizes customer impact.

Maria G: agree. plan: Sam to open PR to pin promote to v2026.3.12 and add release note that feature is delayed; Jordan to kick off manual promote once PR merged; Sam opens chart fix PR and adds test to catch deprecated CRD apiVersion.

Sam: creating PRs now. will tag @Jordan when ready. PR: https://git.internal/repo/promo-pin/123

Jordan: ack. I'll prepare the manual promote runbook and the release note blurb: "Feature X delayed; rolling back to previous canary to meet cut". Any objections?

Maria G: no objections. please include contact for follow-up and ETA for re-canary in the notes. thanks :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: ACTION: promo pinned to v2026.3.12 (manual override) by Jordan at 4412345890. Release window maintained.

Sam: created chart fix PR for the CRD change and added unit test. link: https://git.internal/repo/charts/456. I'll queue a rerun after infra stabilizes.

Maria G: great. closing hold. we'll update customers in the release notes.
